name: Malleenet
summary: Small regional ISP (Malleenet Internet Services, 44 Scoresby St Kerang VIC) offering dialup, dedicated/satellite links and web hosting; by Dec 2006 the domain served the iiNet homepage, consistent with iiNet absorption.

events.details: Business names Malleenet ISP / Malleenet Internet transferred to Connect West Pty Ltd ACN 073 156 779; by Dec 2006 malleenet.net.au served iiNet homepage.

refs.label: Connect West business names: Malleenet ISP 08 Oct 2004 - 05 Jun 2009
